description: This file defines API routes for authentication, including user registration, login, and retrieving current user information, using FastAPI with SQLAlchemy ORM.

methods.name: TokenResponse register(payload: RegisterRequest, db: Session = Depends(get_db))
methods.description: Handles user registration by creating user and profile records, assigning the 'student' role, and returning a JWT token.

methods.name: TokenResponse login(payload: LoginRequest, db: Session = Depends(get_db))
methods.description: Validates user credentials and returns a JWT access token.

methods.name: UserPublic me(user: User = Depends(get_current_user), db: Session = Depends(get_db))
methods.description: Returns information about the authenticated user, including roles.

ctags.name: login
ctags.pattern: /^def login(payload: LoginRequest, db: Session = Depends(get_db)) -> TokenResponse:$/

ctags.name: me
ctags.pattern: /^def me(user: User = Depends(get_current_user), db: Session = Depends(get_db)) -> UserPublic:$/

ctags.pattern: /^def register(payload: RegisterRequest, db: Session = Depends(get_db)) -> TokenResponse:$/
